email_draft.subject: Whispering Pines' SPED stack, reconsidered | Journify
email_draft.body:
Sara Kowalski at Reach Capital mentioned your superintendent joined in February and is actively rethinking the district's SPED technology stack, and suggested this was the right moment for an introduction.

With roughly 882 students on IEPs, the paperwork burden across your case managers, teachers, and related-service providers is real, and a stack transition is the rare window to fix it right. Journify sits on top of SEIS and gives your whole IEP team a shared workspace for drafting, progress monitoring, and instructional materials. Teachers report saving more than four hours per day, which means your team's time shifts back toward students instead of documentation.

If a 20-minute conversation before the superintendent's evaluation window closes sounds useful, I can work around her calendar.
